expected_findings.root_cause: the new enabled flag is stored on the retry object but only checked inside wraps(), so the direct call, iterator and async paths retry regardless of it
expected_findings.failure_path: Retrying(enabled=False, stop=stop_after_attempt(3))(f) where f raises ValueError: f is called three times and RetryError is raised, identical to enabled=True; only the decorator path honors the flag
